# PREMA Real-World Outcome Learning Skill

## Overview
Guidelines for training and calibrating PREMA's compatibility weights based on real-world relationship outcomes rather than app retention or swipe vanity metrics.

---

## 🎯 The Real-World Learning Loop

```
Match Created
      ↓
Intentional Conversation Started
      ↓
PREMA Date Booked & Checked In
      ↓
Post-Date Reflection Completed
      ↓
Second Date Confirmed
      ↓
Long-Term Feedback Signal Collected
      ↓
Compatibility Weight Calibration
```

---

## 🛑 Optimization Goal Discipline

- **Target Metric**: High 2nd-date rate, positive post-date reflection ratings, long-term connection.
- **Forbidden Optimization Metrics**:
  - ❌ Total swipes per user session.
  - ❌ Total minutes spent inside app.
  - ❌ Push notification click-through rate spikes.
  - ❌ Profile view counts.

PREMA's business model succeeds when users find genuine long-term partners, NOT when users are trapped in an addiction loop.
